xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
01. The above consolidated financial results, which have been prepared in accordance with Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with SEBI Circular dated 5 July 2016, have been reviewed by the Audit Committee in their meeting dated 12-Nov-2026 and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 12-Nov-2026. The above consolidated financial results have been subjected to limited review by the Statutory Auditors.

02. This consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (IND AS) notified under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, as amended by the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) (Amendment) Rules, 2016.

03. The office of the Director General (DG) of the Competition Commission of India (CCI) conducted a search on 27 October 2021 at the Company’s registered office regarding the supply and sale of its IMIL products; following an order dated 20 March 2024 where the CCI rejected the Company's preliminary jurisdictional objections and remitted the matter to the DG for further investigation with directions to provide statements and cross-examination access, the Company challenged the CCI's jurisdiction via Writ Petition before the Hon’ble High Court of Madhya Pradesh, which subsequently dismissed the bunch of writ petition on ground of alternative remedies on 17 September 2026 upholding CCI’s jurisdiction, against which the Company has preferred a Special Leave Petition before the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India, where the matter currently remains pending without any material adverse financial impact anticipated at this stage.

04. On September 4, 2025 the Holding Company converted the 9,00,000 shares warrants allotted on March 28, 2024 into equity shares after the receipt of balance 75% allotment monies amounting to Rs. 32.74 crores. The funds raised from these warrants are designated for providing loans or making investments in the wholly-owned subsidiary, "Associated Alcohols and Breweries (Awadh) Limited," to establish a bottling cum distillery unit in Uttar Pradesh. As of 30-Sep-2026, the funds received against the share warrants have been kept in liquid fund earmarked for the aforementioned purpose with a scheduled commercial bank.

05. On April 16, 2026, the National Company Law Tribunal, Kochi (NCLT) approved the Holding Company's resolution plan for the acquisition of SDF Industries Limited under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) and the entity became a wholly-owned subsidiary effective May 13, 2026.

Based on the final valuation, the Holding Company recognized the identifiable assets acquired at a fair value of Rs. 3,506.37 Lakhs. The total purchase consideration transferred to obtain control (comprising the fresh equity infusion) was Rs. 1,250.00 Lakhs. The inter-company loans infused by the Holding Company to settle the target's legacy CIRP costs and creditor obligations have been eliminated upon consolidation.

Consequently, the Holding Company recognized a Capital Reserve (Bargain Purchase Gain) of Rs. 1,182.54 Lakhs on the acquisition, which has been routed through Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) in accordance with Ind AS 103 'Business Combinations'. The provisional amounts recognized for this transaction in the previous quarter ended June 30, 2026, have been retrospectively adjusted in these financial results to reflect these final acquisition-date fair values.

06. There was no exceptional item during any of the reporting period.

07. The figures for the previous period/year have been regrouped and reclassified to confirm the classification of the current period, wherever necessary.
